verdict_text:
NO

The artifact removes head 6 (`DROP_HEAD = 6`), but the specification requires removing head 5. This violates the "Required result" clause: "For every layer `i`, remove head 5 (heads are numbered from 0)." The kept column/row ranges (`0..319, 384..767, ...`) in the spec correspond to dropping the block at offset `320..383` (head 5), whereas the artifact drops the block at offset `384..447` (head 6), producing different values (though the same shapes) than required. Since grading is bit-exact against a reference with head 5 removed, this output will fail grading despite passing all the shape/count assertions.
expected_defect: The removed head is off by one (head N+1 instead of head N). All shapes are still correct, so the artifact's own shape checks pass.
